connector.name: stat-api - Sports Data
connector.registryDescription: NFL/NBA/MLB/NHL/PGA + DFS and prediction-market data. Browse free; query with a free API key.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.stat-api.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.stat-api, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer <api-key> — required for data tools; catalog tools (list_leagues, list_tables, describe_table) work anonymously. Free tier at https://stat-api.com
